samples.summary: `sheets export` still writes a progress notice to **stdout** gated by `--quiet` — the one call site left inconsistent with the new `--quiet` contract this change establishes
samples.evidence: packages/cli/src/commands/sheets-export.ts:52-54 — `if (!opts.quiet) { console.log(`Exported to ${file}`); }`. The change redefines the contract (root.ts:56 help text: "Suppress progress notices (result body and errors still print)"; formatter.ts:21-24: "`--quiet` … gates progress notices only"; docs/design/cli.md:1008-1018: notices go to stderr, stdout is the body). Every other quiet-gated notice in the package now writes to stderr — binary.ts:39, docs/content.ts:107/112/120/142, slides/content.ts:96/105, notes/content.ts:85, files/upload.ts:192-195, docs.ts:292/307. This one writes to stdout, so it is the only remaining place where `--quiet` changes what appears on stdout, and where a non-quiet run pollutes the stream callers redirect (`wafflebase sheets export doc file > x`). The fix belongs at this out-of-diff site (switch to `console.error`), not on the new code.

samples.summary: Only `sheets cells batch` had its input read/parse moved inside the try; the sibling import paths were audited and are already covered, but `readInput` reading fd 0 can still fail before any envelope in other shapes
samples.evidence: packages/cli/src/commands/sheets-import.ts:45-47 wraps `readInput`/`JSON.parse` in the try, so it is fine; I list it only to record the audit. I grepped all command actions for `JSON.parse`, `readFileSync` and `process.stdin` (packages/cli/src/commands/*) and found no remaining pre-try input parse other than the one this change fixed in cells.ts. No broken caller found — this finding is informational and can be dropped by the verifier.
